title: MOTION (HUTT - NAZARIAN) relative to funding for the construction of speed humps along Garth Avenue, Ardmore Avenue, and Kingsley Drive in Council District…
text:
[Council File 26-0011-S23; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HUTT - NAZARIAN) relative to funding for the construction of speed humps along Garth Avenue, Ardmore Avenue, and Kingsley Drive in Council District Ten (CD 10).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $50,000 in the Council District 10 portion of the Council Discretionary Street Furniture Fund No. 43D/50 to a new Account in the Transportation Trust Fund No. 840/94 entitled "CD 10 Speed Humps" for the construction of speed humps along Garth Avenue, Ardmore Avenue, and Kingsley Drive in Council District 10.
2. AUTHORIZE the Department of Transportation to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
